text: The tunnel widens into a rough junction. Long claw marks rake the floor toward the western mouth, where a warm animal musk drifts out on still air. The eastern tunnel runs colder; water ticks steadily from its ceiling into the dark. Both ways are open. Neither is marked.

choices.label: Study the claw marks on the floor
